entries.description: Through pre_tool, a Write to harness/state/session.json is refused, with a reason naming harness/state.
Shell redirects, tee, cp, node -e, and --allow-check-edit are refused when they target harness/state or run the flag.
A session record whose hash no longer matches check-edits.log is not accepted. check-integrity reports check-weakened.
--allow-check-edit refuses when an agent environment marker is set. The test sets each marker in turn.
The harness's own writes to harness/state (session, report, retro) still work.
With tool claude and profile default in the config, and no session, --allow-check-edit writes tool claude and profile default.
--backlog triage and --allow-check-edit use newAdhocSession and produce the same fallback session fields.
The report-against-prd skill names the four sections and the verdict line.

The acceptance-checker prompt contains the three duties. Fake-provider fixtures expect FAIL for a field read but never written, a helper-only end-to-end test, and a protection with no shell-route test.
report-present fails when every criterion passes and REPORT.md is missing or ends in FAIL, and passes when it ends in PASS.
The three REPORT.md files end in acceptance-checker: PASS, and report-present is green on this tree.
doc-drift fails on a fixture for each of the six drift cases and passes on this tree.
A search of the docs for the retired host name returns only accepted ADRs 0001, 0004, and 0006.
AGENTS.md has the state boundary line and stays within limits.agentsMdLines. context-budget is green.
The README What changed section covers PRs 2 to 4 and this PRD, with links to the three specs and their reports.
